questions.question: What is the focus of Lamentations 2?
options: The wealth of the nations brought to Zion
The Lord's steadfast love restored to Zion
The Lord's fierce anger poured out on Zion
The joyful return of the exiles to Zion
questions.answer: The Lord's fierce anger poured out on Zion

questions.question: What does the poet say the prophets of Jerusalem had seen?
options: Glowing promises of a very swift return back home from the exile
Sweet songs of comfort sung aloud in all of the city streets
False and deceptive visions, not exposing the people's iniquity
True and solemn warnings that the people utterly refused to hear
questions.answer: False and deceptive visions, not exposing the people's iniquity

questions.question: Lamentations 2 describes children fainting from hunger in the streets of the city.
